sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Level banner and achievement cards
sections.what: Shows the owner's level, name, XP and progress bar, then a grid where each stored achievement appears as a card. Unlocked cards are green and locked cards are dimmed.
sections.why: Gives the owner a clear record of earned milestones.
sections.watch_out: The XP percentage divides by the next-level target without a zero check.

sections.name: AchievementsView (part 1)
sections.title: Card details and rewards
sections.what: Each card shows its title, description, XP reward, and unlock time if it has one.
sections.why: Explains what each achievement is and what it is worth.

sections.name: AchievementsView (part 2)
sections.title: Achievement reward and unlock date
sections.what: Shows the XP reward for each achievement at the bottom of its card, in green. It also shows the unlock date in small grey text when one has been saved.
sections.why: Likely reason: lets the user see at a glance what each achievement is worth and when it was earned. Reason for this exact layout not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: The unlock date is printed exactly as stored, so its format depends on how the achievement data was saved.

summary: A simpler achievements page that shows the owner's level, XP progress, and a grid of achievements from the store.
purpose: Displays the owner's earned and locked achievements.
why: Offers a plain view of achievements without seasonal challenges or fallback badges.
how: It reads the profile and achievements from the store, works out XP progress, then draws the level header and a card for each achievement. Unlocked cards are highlighted and locked ones are dimmed.
inputs: Profile and achievements from the store.
outputs: A page of cards on screen. Nothing is changed.
risks: If the store has no achievements, the grid is empty with no message. The XP percentage has no guard against a zero target.
debug: If the grid is empty, check whether achievements are loaded into the store. If the XP bar is wrong, check the profile values.
